answer.rationale: Negotiating terms with the incumbent is the only action that simultaneously addresses the mandatory 18% cost reduction and the non-negotiable delivery stability requirement. Switching the primary vendor (memory_c2) or adding a second source (memory_c3) would introduce unacceptable delivery risk to the 94%-utilized line with no buffer. Simple renewal (memory_c1) cannot meet the finance mandate. Deferring (memory_c5) is impossible due to the 14-day contract expiry. Memories c4 and c6 demonstrate that incumbent negotiation—via market benchmarking and volume commitments—can yield significant cost improvements without disrupting integration or delivery.
